sole source of fetal nutrition, so they should eat foods that are necessary for proper fetal development. Folic acid, 
iron, calcium, vitamin D, DHEA, and iodine all play vital roles in this development (Getz, 2022). The nurse can 
educate the pregnant client about specific foods to ensure that their fetus will get these needed nutrients (Table 
18.1).
